supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The ridge extends significantly beyond the lateral canthi of the eyes, creating a prominent horizontal boundary.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-grey muzzle and the dark-pigmented periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thick lower lip with a visible structural droop exposing the mucosal margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent sub-orbital skin folds and deep nasolabial furrows.
